rationale: v1.4.0 (2026-10-03) re-bases this file on the LIVE runtime policy. Before this, the runtime channel_operations_profiles row had drifted ahead of the file (main_episode enabled on TikTok/Instagram/Facebook -- for a short-native channel the main episode IS the Short), and twinkle_mini_tales' file was a byte-identical copy of hypogeum's (channel_id 'hypogeum'). Syncing the old file would have silently stopped TikTok/Instagram/Facebook publishing. Content below = the runtime policy as of 2026-10-03 plus youtube.madeForKids.
made_for_kids_source: Operator decision, 2026-10-03 (Postiz migration): YouTube's COPPA declaration is set explicitly per channel. twinkle_mini_tales is a children's channel -> true. Zernio drops youtube platform_settings, so this changes nothing on the Zernio path; PostizProvider requires it and refuses to publish to YouTube without it.
ai_disclosure_source: Mirrors the live runtime policy (ai_disclosure=true on YouTube and Instagram).
known_gaps: v1.4.0: re-based on the live runtime policy (see rationale) and adds youtube.madeForKids.
installation: Applied via hypogeum.channel_config.sync_platform_distribution_policy_to_runtime(channel_id='twinkle_mini_tales') -- the sole sanctioned path from this versioned file into the runtime channel_operations_profiles row. That function verifies this file's live sha256 against channel_package_manifest.json's registered 'platform_distribution_policy' artifact entry (fails closed on drift) before compiling it into update_channel_operations_profile(). A direct update_channel_operations_profile(platform_deliverable_policy=...) call that bypasses this file is no longer the sanctioned way to change this channel's platform policy.
